create.name: Catherine Andrews
create.bio:
Catherine Andrews is a Tarot reader, feng shui consultant and spiritual coach who works mainly with highly sensitive and neurodivergent women. She worked for years in senior corporate roles while living in Washington, DC, and describes herself as having been an atheist until a gradual and somewhat reluctant awakening in her late thirties, which began when a Tarot deck started to make unexpected sense to her. She went on to train in Reiki levels one and two, feng shui and space clearing, and later in nutritional therapy, and she now lives in an old cottage in the Virginia countryside.

Her teaching is practical and down to earth: Tarot as a tool for reflection, the home as a partner in intention-setting, simple seasonal rituals, journaling, shadow work and manifestation for people who feel things strongly. She offers ninety-minute intuitive coaching calls that draw on Tarot, astrology and feng shui, live and recorded readings, and home consultations over Zoom. Alongside these sit self-paced courses such as The Joyful Tarot, Practical Spirituality and The Intentional Home, a library of hour-long recorded workshops, a shared membership with a friend, and occasional in-person moon circles in Loudoun County. She also writes a weekly newsletter and hosts a podcast, both called The New Sensitive.

courses.title: Intuitive Coaching Call
courses.description: A single ninety-minute call that combines Tarot, astrology, feng shui and channelled guidance with plain practical coaching to work through a block or a turning point. The recording and a follow-up email with next steps are included.

courses.title: The Joyful Tarot
courses.description: A seven-week self-paced course on reading Tarot in an intuitive, supportive and enjoyable way, for beginners and returning readers alike.

courses.title: Practical Spirituality
courses.description: A six-week self-paced course on building a personal reflection practice and a felt connection with the inner and outer worlds, using simple spiritual tools.

courses.title: The Intentional Home
courses.description: An eight-week course that simplifies feng shui, energy work and home ritual into practical steps anyone can use in their own living space.

courses.title: Tarot for Beginners
courses.description: A recorded one-hour workshop introducing the Tarot deck and some first practical ways to work with the cards.

courses.title: How to Do Shadow Work
courses.description: A recorded workshop explaining what shadow work is and offering exercises to begin noticing and integrating the disowned parts of oneself.

courses.title: Finding Your North Node
courses.description: A recorded workshop on the North Node in a birth chart, what its sign and house suggest about life direction, and how the South Node shows older habits.

courses.title: Manifestation for Highly Sensitive People
courses.description: A recorded workshop setting out twelve steps for manifesting, adapted for sensitive temperaments, with examples from her own life.

courses.title: How to Run a Magical Home
courses.description: A recorded workshop on treating a house as a partner in everyday ritual and intention, drawing on feng shui and simple home magic.

Identity: found through a web search on her name (podcast page names catherinedandrews.com); the Shift list entry has no other detail to confirm it is the same Catherine Andrews.

HEALTH, please look: her About page tells her own story at length in condition terms (back pain, perimenopause, adrenal depletion, hair loss, sobriety) and describes her as a Nutritional Therapy Practitioner and holistic health coach; several workshops are nervous-system, EFT or anxiety themed. All of those are left out; what remains is Tarot, feng shui, astrology and spirituality teaching, which is most of her course list. Owner may prefer to skip her under the health rule.
Her About page also calls her an 'advocate of and mentor for microdosing psilocybin'; nothing of that is in the plan.
